name: typesensekit-cli
description: TypesenseKit CLI (`tsk`, packages/cli) in a Bash tool restricted to tsk plus basic text tools. No MCP.
promptHint: You have a Bash shell. The `tsk` command is a Typesense CLI that is already configured to talk to the cluster. Discover its usage with `tsk operations`, `tsk <operation> --help`, `tsk <operation> --schema`, and `tsk <operation> --examples`. Besides `tsk`, only basic text tools (jq, head, tail, grep, wc, sort, uniq, cut, tr, echo, printf) are available.
